681.text: "I want my loved ones out of the country immediately. But I cannot and will not abandon my kingdom."

682.speaker: Player_Romus
682.text: "Vina, doesn't Manus have any connections left within the movement? Can he lower the temperature?"

687.speaker: Narrator
687.text: Laurento's look was one of pure compassion.

688.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
688.text: "I never would have said this to your father in the 1920s. Because he never would have stood to hear it."

689.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
689.text: "But, Your Majesty... The Kingdom of Rizia has lasted over three centuries. A grand success by any historical standard."

690.speaker: Lucita Azaro
690.text: "Distressingly, we have radio silence from the team sent to rescue Princess Vina."

691.speaker: Titus Gordion
691.text: "And according to General Carlos, there is radio silence from the team sent to rescue Princess Vina."

692.speaker: Player_Romus
692.text: "All of you are to blame for this. I trusted you to advise me, and you failed."

693.speaker: Elena Werner
693.text: "I am so sorry, Your Majesty. I never thought it would go this far."
